description: E2E specification contract — critical paths defined, flows span multiple routes, selectors accessible, no hardcoded credentials

rules.title: Critical paths declared
rules.description: At least one flow marked criticalPath: true for pre-deploy gate

rules.title: Flows span multiple routes
rules.description: Every flow covers ≥2 routes — single-route flows are component tests

rules.title: Base URL from environment
rules.description: baseUrl must use ${ENV_VAR} syntax — no hardcoded localhost

rules.title: No hardcoded credentials
rules.description: passwords/tokens must not appear as literal values in spec

rules.title: Local retries forbidden
rules.description: retries.local must be 0 — local retries hide flaky tests

rules.title: Accessible selectors only
rules.description: Page objects must use getByRole/getByLabel, not CSS selectors

rules.title: Screenshots on failure
rules.description: failureArtifacts.screenshot must be true for CI diagnosis
